title.en: Back on the Formula 1 calendar for 2027
title.uk: Повернення до календаря Формули 1 у 2027 році

text.en: The last Formula 1 races at the Algarve International Circuit were the 2020 and 2021 Portuguese Grands Prix, both won by Lewis Hamilton. On 16 December 2025 Formula 1 announced that it will return to the Autódromo Internacional do Algarve, a 4.6 km track at Portimão, for 2027 and 2028 under a two-year agreement with the Portuguese government, Turismo de Portugal and the promoter Parkalgar. The announcement did not give race dates.
text.uk: Останніми гонками Формули 1 на Міжнародному автодромі Алгарве стали Гран-прі Португалії 2020 і 2021 років, обидва виграв Льюїс Гамільтон. 16 грудня 2025 року Формула 1 оголосила, що повернеться на Autódromo Internacional do Algarve, 4,6-кілометрову трасу в Портімау, у 2027 і 2028 роках за дворічною угодою з урядом Португалії, Turismo de Portugal і промоутером Parkalgar. Дат гонок в анонсі не вказано.

sources.locator: Announcement of 16 December 2025: circuit, last races, agreement parties

limitations: Non-F1 use of the circuit between 2021 and 2027 was not confirmed by any opened page, so the legacy text does not describe it; a web search summary mentioned World Superbike, MotoGP, ELMS and GT World Challenge in 2026, which an editor should source from the circuit's official calendar.
No opened source names corners 1-14 and tied them to turn numbers; all are listed as without established name. A search summary mentioned a corner named after Craig Jones, unverified and unlocated.
